The Reference Data team plays a highly critical role in supporting investment activity, operational integrity, and client servicing across the organization by delivering trusted data relied upon throughout the firm. In this role, the analyst will partner with internal stakeholders and external data vendors, perform essential data operations, and help drive continuous improvement in data quality, controls, and scalable processes that support the investment lifecycle. - Support investment teams with security setup and maintenance across equities, fixed income and derivatives.

- Leverage market data vendors and rating agencies, including Bloomberg, Markit, and major ratings providers to analyze and validate data changes

By partnering with Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, and Sales, we identify the right levers - such as prioritization, promotions, pricing, and demand shaping - and help turn them into scalable programs. The Role

Are you curious, willing to learn, and interested in developing algorithms with signal processing and machine learning to enhance the use of SONAR for our nation's Naval Operations?

Interested in collaborating on small project teams with mentors to aid your career development?

If you’re pursuing a degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Mathematics/Statistics and want to develop algorithms for the undersea domain, consider joining our team! We strive to cultivate an environment of collaboration and partnership with our highly skilled staff who regularly tackle difficult problems. We develop algorithms for the undersea domain in a collaborative small project team environment – and the algorithms we develop make a difference in real-world operations.

We are seeking an intern to help us apply information processing, machine learning, deep learning, and signal processing to transform raw sensor data into meaningful information for our nation’s warfighters. As examples, you may work with a mentor to develop algorithms to process active and passive sonar returns to find submarines or use signal processing and deep learning with imaging sonar to identify sea bottom-mounted mines.

As a member of the Maritime Information Exploitation group you will…

- Provide contributions to projects developing innovative algorithms for real-world operations.
- Work with raw and processed sensor data to find hidden patterns and weak signals, identify characteristics, and exploit those characteristics with novel algorithms.
- Document your algorithms, algorithm performance, and insights in written reports and briefings to Leadership and sponsors.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

- Have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics/Statistics, Physics or related field.
- Are skilled in or have working knowledge of a programming language such as Python, MATLAB, or C/C++.
- Have strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively in small project teams.
- Are curious about signal processing, machine learning, deep learning, or artificial intelligence.
- Have a minimum 3.0 GPA on a 4.0 scale.
- Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

- Algorithm development and testing experience and data analysis in languages like Python or MATLAB, particularly for time series or sensor data.
- Experience with Fourier transforms, digital signal processing, feature-based machine learning models (e.g. support vector machines, random forests), and/or deep learning models.
- Led small project teams to successfully accomplish a technical objective.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.

At Klaviyo, our Engineering teams build scalable, high-performance systems that power both our product and the infrastructure behind it. As a Software Engineering Co-op, you'll be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team whose work reaches thousands of customers worldwide. You won't just be writing code. You'll be solving hard problems, shaping how users experience our product, and learning from engineers who've been doing this for a while.

This co-op is your shot to put your software development skills to work in production. You'll be embedded on one of our engineering teams (see overviews below), take on projects that matter to our customers, and build a technical foundation as you make connections across the business.

Our co-ops come from all kinds of coding backgrounds, but they all share one thing: they're excited to build, own, and scale features end-to-end, from scratch. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, take on hard technical problems, and ship code that supports Klaviyo's mission. We're an AI-first company, so you'll be expected to use AI tools to support your work, learn faster, and do your best work here.

How you'll make an impact

- Own features that our 180K+ paying customers rely on daily to reach their consumers and grow their business.

- Take responsibility for the mission, technical direction, and operation of projects with immediate impact.

- Own the full lifecycle of your code: writing it, testing it, shipping it, and making it better over time. Ownership is expected here, not just encouraged.

- Build and ship features that meet a high bar and grow your technical skills while you do it.

- Get hands-on debugging real issues, both locally and in production.

- Contribute to documentation and support your team during incidents (real-world problems teach you things a tutorial never will).

- Work closely with your teammates: ask questions, share ideas, and get better by taking feedback seriously.

- Learn to use the right tool for the job, lean into AI, and keep looking for ways to make things better.

- Put AI at the center of how you work to move faster. Build smarter systems and better workflows from the ground up.

Who you are

- At least one previous software engineering internship or co-op, with hands-on software development experience

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math/Statistics, or a related field

- Graduating in December 2027 or May/June 2028

- Experience with some of these technologies and languages:

- Python, Django, Typescript, React, Go

- MySQL, Cassandra, Clickhouse, Kafka, Redis

- Amazon Web Services (EC2, RDS, Aurora, etc.), Terraform

- You enjoy working across new technologies and you’re excited to work across the stack from back-end to front-end work

- You love digging into performance and scalability issues to find breakthrough solutions: a slow-loading UI, too many clicks in a workflow, a database query timing out, a queue that won't drain. You believe every problem can be solved, and you'd rather run toward it than around it.

- You enjoy shipping code early and often, working closely with products to build better software based on feedback from thousands of end users.

- You embrace Klaviyo's "always learning" culture. We learn faster together, which is part of why this program happens in person.

- You've already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you're excited to find ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.

Co-op logistics

- Our Spring Co-op Program is a paid experience [January 4–June 25] at our Boston, MA headquarters. Co-ops are in office 5 days a week.

- Offers will be team agnostic. Co-ops are placed on a team approximately 30 days from the start of the program. Team placement can be on a full-stack, back-end, or front-end team within any of the pillars.

- Before joining individual teams, all co-ops go through Klaviyo Base Camp, our onboarding experience built to get you up to speed on Klaviyo, our product, and the day-to-day of engineering here.

- Our Boston office is genuinely fun. Lunch is on us 5 days a week, along with free snacks and drinks, ping pong, Nintendo Switch, a golf simulator, and a speakeasy to unwind in.

- Throughout the program, co-ops get together for social events beyond team and project work: a Red Sox game, trips to Versus and Activate, ice cream socials, and Ask Me Anything sessions with Klaviyo's senior leadership.

- Apply before October 7 if you can. We interview and hire on a rolling basis.

Former co-op projects

- Redesigned and refactored the email editor component architecture for performance and scalability, including reusable shared components and testing coverage improvements.

- Developed and deployed a new invite management microservice handling multiple roles, statuses, and integrations with audit logs.

- Built a real-time data ingestion and aggregation pipeline using kinesis and redshift, with monitoring and validation.

- Designed and implemented an automated rollback system that detects new unhandled sentry errors and notifies deployers via Slack.

- Own the WhatsApp double opt-in (DOI) feature end-to-end, integrating backend validation, frontend UI, and monitoring dashboards.

- Integrated AI-assisted tools into build validation pipelines, measuring productivity impact and creating internal best practices guide.

Engineering at Klaviyo

Our engineering teams are organized into pillars to keep the work focused.

- Data Infrastructure: Empower our internal teams and customers to get the best out of our data and agent platforms. underlying capabilities: Agent Platform, CDP revenue, Data Lake usage, Active API endpoints, Accounts with healthy API usage

- MCMI: Own the growth, revenue, and reliability of our mobile channels and all messaging infrastructure.

- Core Infrastructure: Empower our internal engineering, sales, and service teams to be as effective as possible by improving productivity of the eng, product, and design teams.

- Growth Marketing Platform: Give marketers the tools they need to engage with their customers, be successful, and know where they stand.

- AI & Analytics: Applies AI, data, and analytics to automate work, surface insights, and help customers make smarter decisions that maximize Klaviyo Attributed Value (KAV).

- Autonomous Service: Builds AI-powered customer service experiences that help resolve issues, support transactions, and connect customers with human assistance when needed.

- Product Security: Engineer the proactive defenses, detection systems, and response tooling that safeguard Klaviyo's customers and their data.

If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't check every box, apply anyway. Some of the strongest Klaviyos didn't start with a perfect resume match.

Overview

NRDC (the Natural Resources Defense Council) works to safeguard the Earth, its people, its plants and animals, and the natural systems on which all life depends. NRDC combines the power of more than 3 million members and online activists with the expertise of some 800 policy advocates, lawyers, scientists, and communication experts to confront the climate crisis, protect nature, ensure the rights of all people to clean air, clean water, and healthy communities. As an international nonprofit environmental organization, NRDC is working to address the world’s most urgent environmental challenges, and advance innovative, science-based, and enforceable solutions.

Since our founding in 1970, NRDC has helped craft and deliver many of America’s foundational environmental laws, including the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act. Today, we continue to lead in advancing and defending strong environmental protections at the local, state, federal and international levels, as well as through the marketplace. Our team works across the United States and around the world, from offices in Chicago, Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, and Washington, D.C., as well as in Beijing, and New Delhi (a subsidiary of NRDC India Pvt. Ltd.).

Supported by our members and online activists, NRDC is driving impactful solutions that confront the climate crisis, defend nature and safeguard public health across Asia, Africa, and the Americas. At NRDC, we believe lasting change happens when people bring their talent, passion, and expertise together for a common purpose: to build a cleaner, healthier, and more resilient world. Learn more at nrdc.org.

Our interns play an active role on the front lines of the environmental movement. Over the course of an internship, NRDC interns work with lawyers, scientists, or policy analysts in different program areas and amass experience that they could not have obtained anywhere else. Interns also have access to various events to enhance their NRDC experience.

NRDC interns may support or work on:

- Research, data collection, and analysis

- Writing and developing materials for state and federal campaigns

- Supporting with designing equitable policy solutions

- Copywriting and editing social media posts and supporting on marketing campaigns

- Brainstorming opportunities for process improvements, new vendors, partnerships, and engagement

- Project management of department and team-wide initiatives

You can find examples of work by our interns on our Careers Page.

Responsibilities

POSITION SUMMARY

NRDC's Development (Fundraising) Department is seeking an undergraduate intern to support ongoing data management and analytics work for our Donor Systems team. This intern will report into the Data Management Reporting & Analytics Specialist. This opportunity is based out of our New York office and interns are expected to be onsite 3 days per week.

The Donor Systems intern will have the opportunity to work on several projects to support the Data Management & Analytics team within Development, which includes but is not limited to: dashboard & report building, data modeling & analysis, documentation, and process improvement. Students interested learning more about the ins and outs of nonprofit operations would thrive in this opportunity.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS

- Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate program

- Rising sophomores, juniors, seniors, and recent graduates (May 2027) are eligible to apply

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Research and/or data analysis skills

- Project management and/or problem solving skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Able to work collaboratively within a team

- Initiative, proactiveness, and creativity

- Commitment to NRDC’s mission, values, and DEI principles

TOOLS

- Experience with Tableau and SQL (Snowflake) is ideal.

- Experience with Git/Version Control and dbt preferred.

DETAILS

- Duration: 10-weeks | Commitment: 35 hours/week

- Summer Session 1: Monday May 24, 2027 – Friday July 30, 2027

- Summer Session 2: Monday June 7, 2027 – Friday August 13, 2027

- Summer Session 3: Monday June 21, 2027 – Friday August 27, 2027

- Hybrid Work Model: Summer Interns are expected to be in office 3 days/week. We will not be able to offer relocation assistance for the summer.

- Stipend: This is a paid internship with a stipend equivalent of $7,000.00 paid bi-weekly over the course of the assignment.

HOW TO APPLY

Please apply via the 'Apply for this job online’ link at the top of the job description on our Careers Page. In your application please include:

- A resume

- A cover letter that highlights your interest in working at NRDC and which summer session(s) you can join

Application Reviews begin the week of October 26. Positions will remain open and applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, but we encourage you to apply early.

If you are applying to multiple internship opportunities and are interested in submitting more than one set of materials, please add new materials per opportunity - do not replace your current materials.

If you have any questions or issues with iCIMS or applying, please reach out to intern-request@nrdc.org. Please do not resubmit your application via email.

Any applications that do not contain the materials above will not be considered complete. Please, no phone calls, emails, or in-person application drop-offs.

NRDC is committed to advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion, both in our work and in our workplace. We believe that celebrating and actively welcoming diverse voices and perspectives is essential to solving the planet's most pressing environmental problems, and we encourage applications from candidates whose identities have been historically under-represented in the environmental movement.

Company Description

The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The three-time MLS Supporters' Shield Winners are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull for which the team is named. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

Purpose of this Internship

The Academy Scouting & Video Analysis Intern will gain hands-on experience within a professional youth academy by supporting the player identification and recruitment process through video analysis. Working alongside the Academy Scouting department, the intern will learn how video evaluation, player profiling, and scouting operations contribute to identifying elite youth talent while developing practical skills used throughout professional soccer.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

Learn the fundamentals of professional academy scouting, talent identification, and player evaluation.

Develop technical skills in video analysis, including clipping, organizing, and presenting player footage using industry-standard software.

Understand how scouting reports, video analysis, and recruitment workflows support player identification and decision-making.

Gain experience organizing scouting databases, maintaining video libraries, and preparing materials for internal scouting discussions.

Improve analytical thinking, written communication, and attention to detail in a professional sporting environment.

Work collaboratively with Academy staff while gaining insight into the day-to-day operations of a Major League Soccer academy.

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and eligible to receive academic credit for the internship.

Pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Sports Analytics, Performance Analysis, Coaching, Data Analytics, Kinesiology, or a related field.

Passionate about soccer, player development, scouting, and performance analysis.

Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and time management skills.

Comfortable reviewing large amounts of match footage and identifying key player actions.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Proficient with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

Experience with video analysis software (Hudl Sportscode, Hudl, Spiideo, Wyscout, or similar platforms) is preferred but not required.

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a professional environment.

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).

Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.
